QUESTION: At FIXED voltage, does the QAL hop's transfer energy fall as 1/T when T is swept, over what range does that law hold, and at what T does the PER-OP floor (switch gate charge + park + timer) take over and stop the saving?
WHY_IT_MATTERS: A CMOS gate burns ~(1/2)CV^2 per transition regardless of clock period. QAL's transfer loss is RESISTIVE, so in principle it falls as 1/T and slowing alone saves energy at constant voltage. The campaign has an ANALYTIC crossover map (E_QAL/E_CMOS = 2*f_adia = 4/tau, tau = T/RC_g, floor-capped 3-9.5x) that has NEVER been measured on the built harness with the real switch and real cells. This track measures it.

HARNESS.base: qal/lsweep/lsw.py VERBATIM (which is sar/sar_observable.py verbatim, which is swsweep/sw_hop_meter.py verbatim, which is gateb's harness verbatim). Copied into tsweep/ as tsw.py with ONLY these changes: (1) HERE/CACHE point at tsweep; (2) the L list extended UPWARD past the committed 277.8 nH; (3) timestep/run-length scaling already present in lsw.py is reused unchanged; (4) a new CMOS comparator stage that lsweep does not have.
HARNESS.device: SG13G2 / PSP103 tt via qal/sg13lv_compat.sp (ZEROES ad/as/pd/ps -- junction capacitance absent; every device number is a LOWER bound on capacitance and therefore an OPTIMISTIC bound on QAL speed and an OPTIMISTIC bound on CMOS energy alike).

fixed_at.cells: 8 x sg13_lv inverter wp=1.12u wn=0.74u, CL=2 fF/cell

HARNESS.T_knob: T is varied THROUGH L: t_hop = pi*sqrt(L*C_ser), C_ser = CA/2 = 17.9895 fF. This is the physical resonant knob and it changes NOTHING about the switch, the cells, the rails or the loss coefficient R. A SECOND, independent knob (series RS) is swept at one L as a MECHANISM CHECK: if the loss is resistive, E_transfer must be LINEAR in R at fixed T.
HARNESS.T_zero_discipline: The true current zero is RE-PROBED per L with its own probe deck (lsw.py probe stage). The analytic pi*sqrt(LC) is used ONLY to size timesteps and run lengths, never as a measured hop time.
HARNESS.metering: 1F-integrator taps only (CX/BX/RX triplets), t0-referenced at the Z checkpoint (0.5 ps) to remove the integrator pedestal. NO '.measure INTEGRAL V(<B-source>)'. Every .measure FIND is requested LAG_PS=1.0 ps late, the measured instrument lag of this Xyce build (lsweep/diag_find.py).

G0_instrument.gate: Reproduce the COMMITTED hop energy row digit-checked. Extract from qal/swsweep/sw_tg15p_z.cir.mt0 and require rel error < 1e-6 on ALL EIGHT committed anchor keys: E_hop_open_fJ=8.3828171771408, VBEND=0.6758936, VBPK=0.7374377, VA_open=0.09778203952305342, cells_burn_fJ=1.6954746104994207, E_R_toC_fJ=0.049543034863200004, IZ_uA=-0.37939849999999997, IPK_uA=194.3655. THEN re-run the committed deck unmodified under MY OWN PyMS cache and require the same 1e-6 on all eight. A FAIL here voids the whole track.
G0_instrument.verdict_if_fail: STOP and report the instrument as broken. No sweep number may be quoted.

PRE_STATED_ACCEPTANCE.R1_per_row_instrument: Every swept row must pass the committed C4 instrument gate: |closure_Q| <= 1.0%, |closure_E| <= 1.0%, |identity at the current zero| <= 0.02 fJ (waveform, not .measure), |xc_dEhop| <= 1.0%. Rows that fail C4 are REPORTED but EXCLUDED from every fit and every headline.

A1_does_E_fall_as_1_over_T.statement: Fit E_transfer = k * T^(-p) by least squares in log-log over the rows that pass R1.
A1_does_E_fall_as_1_over_T.accept_1_over_T: p in [0.90, 1.10] over a contiguous span of at least one decade in T.
A1_does_E_fall_as_1_over_T.reject: p outside [0.90, 1.10], or no contiguous decade.
A1_does_E_fall_as_1_over_T.also_report: the T at which the local slope d(log E)/d(log T) departs from -1 by more than 0.1, in BOTH directions.

A2_where_does_the_per_op_floor_take_over.definition: T_floor is the T at which the PER-OP terms equal the T-DEPENDENT term. Per-op terms are, in increasing completeness: (i) the measured switch gate-drive E_gate_drive_fJ (ideal-PWL, the harness's own booking); (ii) the committed resonant gt/gtp pair 2.974 fJ; (iii) the committed COMPLETE timer ledger 23.213 fJ/bank/hop. T-dependent term is E_R_toC + the resistive part of the switch block.
A2_where_does_the_per_op_floor_take_over.report: T_floor for each of the three completeness levels, and the floor-capped total-energy ratio E_QAL_total(T)/E_QAL_total(T->inf).

A3_CMOS_comparator.statement: Measure the SAME 8 cells as static CMOS on a hard rail, energy per transition, at the SAME T points -- the input edge / period is swept over the same span the QAL hop is swept over.
A3_CMOS_comparator.accept_T_invariant: spread of E_CMOS per transition across the T span <= 10% (a CMOS gate's dynamic energy is set by C and V, not by rate; leakage adds a small T-PROPORTIONAL term at the slow end and is reported separately).
A3_CMOS_comparator.if_not_T_invariant: report the measured T dependence and use the MEASURED curve, not the (1/2)CV^2 idealisation, in every ratio.

A4_tau_at_crossover.statement: tau = T / RC_g with RC_g MEASURED on this cell in this deck (not assumed, not the campaign's ~12 ps folklore). Report the measured tau at which E_QAL/E_CMOS crosses 1, against the map's prediction tau=4.

PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.confidence: MEDIUM. Derived from the COMMITTED lsweep rows (already on disk, REPORT.txt), which is why it is written down here before any new deck: it must be falsifiable by the new slow rows.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.E1_the_1_over_T_law_HOLDS_on_the_slow_si: Committed rows give E_R+E_swblk times t_hop = 184.6 / 180.2 / 176.7 / 173.9 / 171.7 / 169.0 / 165.4 / 163.1 / 161.8 / 160.3 / 158.5 / 156.5 fJ*ps at L = 277.8 down to 30 nH -- constant to +-8%, i.e. p ~ 1. I expect p in [0.90, 1.00] over L >= 30 nH (T >= 86 ps) and a clear DEPARTURE below T ~ 50 ps (at L = 10/3/1 the product falls to 140.4 / 119.3 / 102.4, p drops well below 1 because the transfer stops completing).
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.E2_THE_FLOOR_HAS_ALREADY_TAKEN_OVER: This is the load-bearing prediction and the one I most expect to be told is wrong. At the COMMITTED anchor (T = 265.6 ps) the T-dependent term is already only ~0.695 fJ while the harness's own measured switch gate drive is ~3.57 fJ -- 5.1x larger. So I predict T_floor at completeness level (i) lies BELOW the committed anchor, somewhere near T = 40-70 ps, and that the whole committed L sweep is ALREADY floor-dominated. At completeness level (iii), with the 23.213 fJ timer ledger, I predict there is NO T in the PDK envelope at which the T-dependent term dominates -- the floor wins everywhere, and the 1/T knob is worth at most a few percent of the total.
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.E3_predicted_crossover_tau: The map says E_QAL/E_CMOS = 1 at tau = 4. With RC_g ~ 18-22 ps (my estimate from the committed cell floor t90 = 40.417 ps at 1.2 V and 51.505 ps at 1.0 V, assuming t90 = 2.3 RC), tau = 4 means T ~ 72-88 ps. I predict the MEASURED crossover tau will be MUCH LARGER than 4 -- i.e. QAL needs to be slowed far more than the map says -- because the map counts only the gate's own adiabatic settle and omits the per-op switch/park/timer charge entirely. My pre-stated number: measured crossover tau >= 12 at completeness level (i), and NO CROSSOVER AT ALL (E_QAL > E_CMOS at every T) at completeness level (iii).
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.E4_floor_capped_ratio: The map's floor cap is 3-9.5x. I predict the MEASURED floor-capped best ratio E_CMOS/E_QAL at completeness level (i) lands at or below the bottom of that band (<= 3x), and is BELOW 1 (i.e. QAL is more expensive) at level (iii).
PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.E5_mechanism_check: E_transfer must be LINEAR in RS at fixed T. If it is not, the loss is not the resistive transfer term and the whole 1/T framing is wrong.

WHAT_WOULD_FALSIFY_ME: E_R + E_swblk continuing to fall as 1/T out to T = 1.5 ns with no floor in sight, and the per-op terms falling with it (they must not -- they are per-op).
E_gate_drive turning out to be T-DEPENDENT (it would mean the switch drive is not a per-op charge).
The measured CMOS comparator turning out to be strongly T-dependent, which would break the like-for-like ratio.
A measured crossover tau near 4, which would VINDICATE the map.
NOT_IN_SCOPE: Track A (the reservoir / CA_MULT sweep) -- a different agent owns it. CA is held at the committed 35.979 fF here.
Any chain / multi-bank result. This is a SINGLE HOP.

Re-opening the committed energy EXCLUSION verdict (complete timer ledger 23.213 fJ/bank/hop vs a pre-stated <= 12.7467 fJ, stat-sim c814e52). That verdict is USED here as a committed per-op anchor; it is not re-litigated.
Any dV other than 1.0 -- the whole point is FIXED voltage.
vt / gmin adjustments, corner runs other than tt.
KNOWN_BIASES_STATED_UP_FRONT: sg13lv_compat.sp zeroes ad/as/pd/ps: junction capacitance is ABSENT. This makes the cells cheaper than reality on BOTH sides (QAL hop and CMOS comparator), so the RATIO is less biased than either absolute number.

The harness's gt/gtp/park drives are IDEAL PWL sources through series R. The E_gate_drive term they meter is therefore a LOWER BOUND on the real per-op switch cost -- the committed campaign measured the real driver at 2.974 fJ (resonant pair, itself a netting of two unconnected ideal sources) up to 23.213 fJ (complete ledger). Every per-op number is reported at all three completeness levels and labelled.
ALL NUMBERS ARE SHALLOW-STACK. The ALU dominant cell sg13g2_o21ai_1 never settles at any operating point in the PDK envelope; nothing here generalises to it.

The rails in this harness are IDEAL SOURCES. Slowing down does not make an ideal source more expensive; in a real design a longer T holds the rails up for longer and costs static power. That term is UNCOSTED here and is stated as such.
